newsitem.title: USA: Mutual funds see positive return in last week July.
newsitem.headline: Mutual funds see positive return in last week July.

text.p: Mutual funds posted generally solid returns for the latest week ending July 31, with the average equity fund gaining 1.38 percent, Lipper Analytical Services said.
Latin American funds continued to show strength, gaining an average of 3.29 percent, Lippper said. Mexico and Brazil remained the driving forces behind the solid returns, it said.
On average, general equity funds rose 1.52 percent in the week, sector equity funds gained 1.33 percent and world equity funds added 1.06 percent, Lipper said.
Among sectors, financial services showed the best gains, rising 2.91 percent for the week. In the past 52 weeks, these funds have risen about 57 percent, Lipper said.
Natural resources funds gained 2.86 percent for the week, while gold funds advanced 2.36 percent.

Health and biotechnology funds posted the only negative returns this week, losing 0.66 percent, Lipper said. Japanese funds, European region funds and international small cap funds all showed small gains.
